slides.title: How did last quarter go?
slides.headline: How did last quarter go?
notes: Statuses were locked in Metronome the day before. Do not update them in the room.
Keep it brief. It can take 30 to 45 minutes while a team is learning.
Use the survey’s lessons and brutal facts. Let the team learn from what went red.
slides.support: Review the 1HAG and last quarter’s QHAG in Metronome.
body: Fiscal numbers: revenue, profit and cash.
Non-fiscal numbers: widgets and head count.
Each priority: was it done, and did it succeed?
Where was your estimate wrong, and what did you learn?
